description: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic (Arkane 2006, Source engine, ElAmigos repack, via Proton)
long: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic is a first-person action RPG built on Valve's Source engine, set in the Might and Magic fantasy universe. Combat emphasizes physics-driven, environmental kills, letting players kick enemies into spike traps, off ledges, or into hazards alongside swords, bows, and magic. This is the single-player campaign following the apprentice Sareth.
name: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic
